description: Symmetry-recombined exact rational order-7 flag-algebra certificate for the K4^(3) tetrahedron Turan problem
mathematical_scope: For an edge-density maximizer in the K4^(3)-free limit space, the first nontrivial order-7 vertex-stationarity identity is zero. Adding an arbitrary multiple of that identity and nonnegative rooted flag squares yields the pointwise seven-vertex coefficient bound verified here.

exact_verification.all_Gram_matrices: Each block is an explicit sum of integer outer products divided by scale^2.
exact_verification.coefficient_arithmetic: All 13,051,375 admissible labeled seven-vertex extensions were checked using signed 128-bit integer arithmetic.

status_note: Exact internal verification passed. This symmetry-recombined variant reduces the square count while retaining essentially the same bound.
maximizer_note: The maximum coefficient is attained by multiple raw labeled seven-vertex masks; the recorded mask is one example.

compression.method: Rank-optimal real S3-Reynolds recombination of the root-triple Gram contributions, followed by integer rounding and exhaustive exact verification.
compression.tradeoff: The exact bound changes by only about 2.29e-7.
